children: Jingrui Wang Pu Holdings Group Ltd., a Cayman Islands holding company that operates in China through contractual arrangements, filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol JRWP. The company plans to offer 6,250,000 Class A ordinary shares at an estimated price range of $4.00 to $6.00 per share, in a firm-commitment deal led by Eddid Securities USA Inc. Proceeds will be used to expand its Jingrui Electric Housekeeper community service centers, develop online systems (including its Weixin Mini Program and service engineer app), and for working capital.

Jingrui Wang Pu is a holding company that conducts operations in China through contractual arrangements, offering retail and wholesale sales of household appliances alongside after‑sales maintenance and consulting services for appliance industry partners. Its retail presence is supported by distribution centers and a growing network of Jingrui Electric Housekeeper community service centers, while sales are complemented by a Weixin Mini Program and a service engineer app to connect customers with on‑demand services.

The company generates revenue primarily from appliance sales, with additional contributions from repair and maintenance services and business consulting to peer retailers. Competitive strengths include a regional supply chain, a field service team (Jingrui Dian Xiao’ers) for door‑to‑door services, and an experienced management team. Proceeds from the IPO aim to expand community service centers, strengthen online operations, and build broader product and service coverage.
: China’s home appliance industry revenue was approximately RMB1.97 trillion in 2025, with exports around $111.41 billion.
: Retail sales of home appliances and communications equipment reached record highs in 2025; early 2026 data show continued double‑digit growth in high energy‑efficiency appliances.
: The company focuses on Shandong province with expansion plans and positions itself as a multi-channel retailer and services provider.
: Large appliance brands’ retail channels (e.g., Midea, Hisense, Casarte) and service marketplaces such as 58.com and Woodpecker.
: Government "trade‑in" incentives, shift to online/social commerce (Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu), and demand for smart, energy‑efficient appliances.
: Mix of individual retail buyers and wholesale distributors
: 10 retail stores; 4 community service centers; 3+ distribution centers
: Primarily Shandong province, China, with plans to expand
: Supplier relationships with major appliance brands and regional malls
: 28,513 appliances sold in FY2026 (25,851 in FY2025)
: 46 distributors (as of FY2026); 2,748 Mini Program registered users; ~12 DAUs and ~126 MAUs; 117 Jingrui Dian Xiao’er service personnel; 47 full‑time and 114 part‑time employees
, Director, Chairperson - Former legal and HR manager with experience in corporate administration and legal affairs.
, Chief Executive Officer - Background in regional operations and investment promotion in the appliance sector.
, Chief Financial Officer - Accounting and financial management experience across multiple operating entities.
, Chief Operating Officer - Operations leadership spanning marketing, finance, and store management.
, Independent Director Nominee - Former chairman at an appliance service association with sector expertise.
, Independent Director Nominee - Senior corporate officer with prior CFO experience at a Nasdaq‑listed affiliate.
, Independent Director Nominee - Attorney and law firm partner with experience in corporate and criminal defense.
: Jingrui Wang Pu Holdings Group Ltd.
: 6,250,000 Class A ordinary shares (plus 937,500 over-allotment option)

: ~55% for expanding Jingrui Electric Housekeeper community service centers; ~15% for developing online systems (Weixin Mini Program and Service Engineer APP); ~30% for working capital and general corporate purposes
